systems.tiers: out-of-camp, Hodh Chargui: UNHCR, through the Education Working Group, works with the national and regional education department to register refugee children in school and in the database

note: No fact: the one mention is that refugee children outside Mbera camp are being registered in school and in the national education database (EMIS), as an activity for 2024. That implies a record per child, but the document does not say schools enter it or what else the database does, so it is unclassified here.
